avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Folic Acid (>5mg daily without medical guidance)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May reduce methotrexate efficacy by competing at dihydrofolate reductase; therapeutic folic acid supplementation (1mg daily) is standard but excessive doses can antagonize drug effect
avoid_supplements.action: Coordinate folic acid supplementation with prescriber; use standard dose of 1mg daily on non-methotrexate days

avoid_supplements.name: NSAIDs (high-dose or chronic)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Decrease renal clearance of methotrexate, increasing toxicity risk; can elevate MTX levels 25-50%
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid NSAIDs entirely if possible; use acetaminophen for pain instead; if NSAID necessary, obtain prescriber approval and monitor renal function closely

avoid_supplements.name: Trimethoprim
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both are dihydrofolate reductase inhibitors; additive toxicity and reduced methotrexate clearance
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; select alternative antibiotic if infection treatment needed

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin A (>10,000 IU daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both hepatotoxic; increases risk of cirrhosis and fibrosis with chronic methotrexate use
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin A to <5,000 IU daily; avoid retinoid supplements; monitor liver function

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance methotrexate immunosuppression leading to decreased vaccine response and increased infection risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue echinacea during methotrexate therapy; consider immune support only under prescriber guidance

caution_supplements.name: Sulfonamides (including sulfasalazine)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May displace methotrexate from protein binding and reduce renal clearance, slightly elevating MTX levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor CBC and renal function more frequently; coordinate with prescriber if concurrent use necessary

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may modestly increase methotrexate metabolism, reducing efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Inform prescriber of use; monitor disease response; consider discontinuation if efficacy concerns

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May affect gut microbiota-mediated enterohepatic circulation of methotrexate; generally beneficial but effects variable
caution_supplements.action: Monitor tolerability and efficacy; probiotics may be beneficial for GI side effects but ensure strain selection with pharmacist

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Hepatoprotective properties may be beneficial given methotrexate hepatotoxicity; limited clinical evidence of interference
caution_supplements.action: May be considered as supportive therapy; monitor liver enzymes regularly

avoid_foods.name: High alcohol consumption (>2 drinks/day)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Both methotrexate and alcohol are hepatotoxic; significantly increases risk of cirrhosis, fibrosis, and hepatic necrosis
avoid_foods.action: Strongly advise complete alcohol avoidance or abstinence during methotrexate therapy; screen for alcohol use disorder

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases methotrexate bioavailability and blood levels; increases toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit and grapefruit juice from diet entirely during methotrexate treatment

avoid_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
avoid_foods.mechanism: High sodium may impair renal function and reduce methotrexate clearance; worsens fluid retention
avoid_foods.action: Adopt low-sodium diet (<2,300mg daily); monitor renal function and blood pressure regularly

caution_foods.name: Raw/undercooked meats and unpasteurized dairy
caution_foods.mechanism: Methotrexate causes immunosuppression increasing infection risk from foodborne pathogens (Listeria, Salmonella)
caution_foods.action: Follow food safety practices: cook meats thoroughly, use pasteurized dairy, wash produce; practice good hygiene

caution_foods.name: High-fat foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase methotrexate absorption and GI side effects; can elevate liver enzyme stress
caution_foods.action: Limit saturated fat intake; maintain balanced, moderate-fat diet to minimize nausea and hepatic burden

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-heavy beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase methotrexate-induced GI irritation and nausea; mild diuretic effect may reduce drug clearance
caution_foods.action: Limit caffeine to <200mg daily; substitute with herbal tea; maintain adequate hydration (2-3L water daily)

monitoring_notes: Monitor CBC, comprehensive metabolic panel (renal and hepatic function), and albumin at baseline and regularly during therapy. Assess for signs of toxicity (mucositis, cytopenias, hepatotoxicity) and ensure adequate folic acid supplementation (1mg daily non-methotrexate days) to mitigate toxicity while preserving efficacy.
